transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

I’ve been hearing things… mostly my name being called, like from the hallway at home. It happened once at the warehouse too, when nobody was there. It sounded real, like someone was right next to me, and it scared me.
Have you used any drugs or alcohol around the times when you heard your name being called?
I don’t think so. I mean… I’m not really sure what counts, but I haven’t noticed it being tied to that.
Have you started believing that someone is deliberately trying to send you messages or target you?
I don’t know… I haven’t really thought of it like that. I can’t say someone’s targeting me, no.
Did something extremely stressful happen in your life shortly before the voices started?
Not that I can think of. I mean, life’s been stressful, but I don’t remember anything really big happening right before it started.
Have you used cannabis recently?
Um… no, not recently. Not that I can think of.
Have you had any seizures, head injuries, or other brain-related medical problems?
Not really… I don’t think so. I haven’t had seizures or anything like that that I know of.
Have you been feeling emotionally flat or numb lately?
I don’t know… maybe a little, but I wouldn’t say flat exactly. I just haven’t really been paying attention to it.
Have you started believing things that other people say aren’t true?

I mean… maybe. I had this idea that I could make my crafts into a real retirement business, like pretty much right away. I thought everybody would see I’d figured out the perfect plan for my family. Some people acted like that wasn’t realistic.
Have there been times when you felt unusually high, euphoric, or on top of the world?

Yeah… at first I did feel kind of fired up, like I was on a roll and nobody could really stop me with the craft business stuff, and the rules at home. But it wasn’t just happy. I’d get irritated fast, especially if my husband said even a little thing that sounded like he was holding me back.
During that fired-up time, did you need much less sleep than usual and still feel energetic?
Yeah… I guess so. I was only sleeping maybe two or three hours for a while, and then I’d wake up ready to get going. It felt like sleeping was just wasting time I needed for my projects.
Did the voices happen only during that fired-up period?

Yeah… it was during that time. When I wasn’t sleeping much and I was kind of… going nonstop, trying to fix everything. I’d hear my name then. Before that, and after I got really low and kept to myself, I don’t think I had that.
